litematica_turbo.message.out_of_memory: [Litematica Turbo] This schematic is too big for the memory Minecraft has (%s MB), so it was not loaded. Give Minecraft more memory or use a smaller schematic.
litematica_turbo.message.storage_off: [Litematica Turbo] Compact schematic storage hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. Schematics are stored the normal Litematica way.
litematica_turbo.message.batch_off: [Litematica Turbo] Batch drawing hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. The schematic is drawn piece by piece, as in normal Litematica.
litematica_turbo.message.copy_off: [Litematica Turbo] Fast placement copying hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. Placements are copied the normal Litematica way.
